title: Bug - Windows release WMO drops Swift Testing registration
description: Swift 6.4's default Windows SwiftPM build system compiled release test targets with WMO but omitted the Swift Testing registration object, producing a successful zero-test run. Debug executed all four tests. Disabling WMO at the Vaporize Windows release-test authority restored registration without changing test sources or Package.swift.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize keeps Swift Testing and #expect in platform test sources.
Vaporize adds -Xswiftc -no-whole-module-optimization only to Windows release test invocations.
Debug and non-Windows test invocations retain their default compilation model.
The DocC browser Windows release suite executes four tests rather than reporting a zero-test success.
risks: The workaround increases Windows release-test compilation time until SwiftPM preserves Swift Testing registration under WMO.
